_comment: Fichier de langue de Le Truc. NE traduis PAS les clés (côté gauche). Traduis uniquement les valeurs (côté droit). Conserve chaque {placeholder} exactement tel quel. Ne traduis jamais les jetons d'action ('[play]', '[raise]', '[accept]', '[fold]'), les étiquettes de cartes/couleurs (p. ex. 3♠, A♥, K♦), les étiquettes de joueur (P0, P1) ni les valeurs numériques de points.

_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or hand
_slots.{points}: A hand point value, e.g. 1, 2 or 4
_slots.{cards}: A space-separated list of the player's card labels, e.g. 'A♦ 3♠ A♥'
_slots.{legal}: A comma-separated list of the currently legal action tokens

player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Le Truc, a 2-player trick game with a 40-card deck (rank high to low: 3 2 A K Q J 7 6 5 4).
Each hand you get 3 cards and play up to three one-card tricks. The higher rank wins a trick regardless of suit; equal ranks tie ('spoilt'). Win the hand by taking two tricks, or by winning the first trick when the other ties; a spoilt trick counts for whoever won the first trick, and if all three tie no one scores.
A hand is worth 1 point. On your turn you may '[raise]' (truc) to increase the stake: 1->2, then +2 for each further raise up to 12. Your opponent must '[accept]', '[fold]', or re-'[raise]'. A player who folds concedes the hand, and the raiser scores the stake from before that raise.
Actions: '[play <rank>]' (e.g. '[play 3]'), '[raise]', '[accept]', '[fold]'. First to 12 points wins the match.

Vos cartes : {cards}

invalid_move.wrong_rank: Vous ne possédez pas ce rang (les couleurs sont ignorées en entrée).
invalid_move.must_respond: A raise is pending - respond with '[accept]', '[fold]', or re-'[raise]' before playing a card.
invalid_move.max_stake: The hand is already worth the maximum (12); you cannot raise further.

action.raise: P{pid} relance - la main vaut maintenant {points} pts. L'adversaire doit '[accept]' ou '[fold]'.
action.accept: P{pid} accepts - the hand is worth {points} pts.
action.spoilt: P{pid} plays {card}. Ranks tie - the trick is spoilt.

outcome.hand_won: Hand won by P{winner} (+{points} pt(s)). Score - P0: {p0}, P1: {p1}.
outcome.void: All three tricks spoilt - no score this hand. Score - P0: {p0}, P1: {p1}.
